recent_en: The company released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2025 on 27 November 2026. On 22 September 2026, there were board and remuneration committee changes: Chen Ying Zhong, Freddy was appointed as a director and joined the remuneration committee, and Tan Phwe Leng also joined the remuneration committee. There were no other major announcements or news recently.
